senses.def: a person whose job is to clean and look after a house
senses.ex: The family hired a housekeeper to look after the house.
senses.exPt: A família contratou uma empregada doméstica para cuidar da casa.

senses.def: a teacher in charge of a house where students live at a boarding school
senses.ex: The housemaster checks that all the boys are in bed by ten.
senses.exPt: O professor responsável pelo internato confere se todos os meninos estão na cama às dez.

senses.def: a woman whose main job is looking after her home and family
senses.ex: My grandmother was a housewife and raised six children.
senses.exPt: Minha avó era dona de casa e criou seis filhos.

senses.def: work like cleaning and washing that you do at home
senses.ex: We share the housework equally at home.
senses.exPt: A gente divide as tarefas domésticas igualmente em casa.

senses.def: to stay in the air in one place
senses.ex: A helicopter hovered above the building for an hour.
senses.exPt: Um helicóptero pairou sobre o prédio por uma hora.

senses.def: to hold the mouse pointer over something on a screen
senses.ex: Hover over the icon to see more information.
senses.exPt: Passe o mouse sobre o ícone para ver mais informações.

senses.def: in what way
senses.ex: How do you spell your name?
senses.exPt: Como se escreve o seu nome?

senses.def: used to add something that is different from what you just said
senses.ex: The hotel was nice. However, the food was terrible.
senses.exPt: O hotel era legal. Porém, a comida era horrível.

senses.def: to put your arms around someone to show love
senses.ex: She hugged her mother at the airport.
senses.exPt: Ela abraçou a mãe no aeroporto.

senses.def: the act of putting your arms around someone
senses.ex: Come here and give me a big hug!
senses.exPt: Vem cá e me dá um abraço bem forte!

senses.def: extremely large
senses.ex: They live in a huge house near the beach.
senses.exPt: Eles moram numa casa enorme perto da praia.

senses.def: very much; to a very great degree
senses.ex: The film was hugely successful around the world.
senses.exPt: O filme foi extremamente bem-sucedido no mundo todo.

senses.def: of or about people
senses.ex: The human body is full of surprises.
senses.exPt: O corpo humano é cheio de surpresas.

senses.def: the basic rights that every person should have
senses.ex: The group fights for human rights around the world.
senses.exPt: O grupo luta pelos direitos humanos no mundo todo.

senses.def: kind and not causing more suffering than necessary
senses.ex: We need a more humane way of treating animals on farms.
senses.exPt: Precisamos de uma forma mais humana de tratar os animais nas fazendas.

senses.def: a person who believes in human reason and values, not religion
senses.ex: He was a humanist who believed in reason and kindness.
senses.exPt: Ele era um humanista que acreditava na razão e na bondade.

senses.def: all people in the world together
senses.ex: Climate change is one of the biggest threats to humanity.
senses.exPt: As mudanças climáticas são uma das maiores ameaças à humanidade.

senses.def: to make something kinder or more suitable for people
senses.ex: The new director wants to humanize the hospital.
senses.exPt: O novo diretor quer humanizar o hospital.

senses.def: not proud, or from a poor or simple background
senses.ex: Despite his success, he's still very humble.
senses.exPt: Apesar do sucesso, ele continua muito humilde.

senses.def: talk or behaviour that is false or dishonest; nonsense
senses.ex: He said all the talk about saving money was just humbug.
senses.exPt: Ele disse que todo aquele papo de economizar dinheiro era pura bobagem.

senses.def: hot and with a lot of water in the air
senses.ex: The weather is very hot and humid in summer.
senses.exPt: O tempo fica muito quente e úmido no verão.

senses.def: to make someone feel ashamed or stupid, especially in front of others
senses.ex: The teacher humiliated him in front of the whole class.
senses.exPt: O professor o humilhou na frente da turma inteira.

senses.def: making you feel ashamed and stupid
senses.ex: Losing seven to nothing at home was a humiliating defeat.
senses.exPt: Perder de sete a zero em casa foi uma derrota humilhante.

senses.def: the feeling of being made to look stupid or weak
senses.ex: He couldn't bear the humiliation of losing in front of his friends.
senses.exPt: Ele não suportava a humilhação de perder na frente dos amigos.

senses.def: the ability to find things funny, or the quality of being funny
senses.ex: She has a great sense of humor.
senses.exPt: Ela tem um ótimo senso de humor.

senses.def: funny and making people laugh
senses.ex: He wrote a humorous story about his dog.
senses.exPt: Ele escreveu uma história engraçada sobre o cachorro dele.

senses.def: the number 100
senses.ex: There were about a hundred people at the party.
senses.exPt: Havia umas cem pessoas na festa.

senses.def: the feeling or state of needing food
senses.ex: Millions of people still suffer from hunger.
senses.exPt: Milhões de pessoas ainda passam fome.

senses.def: wanting or needing to eat
senses.ex: I'm hungry. Let's have lunch now.
senses.exPt: Estou com fome. Vamos almoçar agora.

senses.def: to chase and kill animals for food or sport
senses.ex: Lions usually hunt at night.
senses.exPt: Os leões normalmente caçam à noite.

senses.def: to look carefully for something or someone
senses.ex: I've been hunting for my keys all morning.
senses.exPt: Passei a manhã toda procurando minhas chaves.

senses.def: a search for someone or something
senses.ex: The hunt for the missing girl continued all night.
senses.exPt: A busca pela menina desaparecida continuou a noite toda.

senses.def: a person or animal that hunts
senses.ex: The hunter walked quietly through the forest.
senses.exPt: O caçador andou em silêncio pela floresta.

senses.def: chasing and killing wild animals for food or sport
senses.ex: Hunting is not allowed in the national park.
senses.exPt: A caça não é permitida no parque nacional.

senses.def: the activity of looking for something, such as a job or a house
senses.ex: House hunting in this city can take months.
senses.exPt: A busca por uma casa nesta cidade pode levar meses.

senses.def: very quickly, because you do not have much time
senses.ex: She dressed hurriedly and ran to catch the bus.
senses.exPt: Ela se vestiu às pressas e correu para pegar o ônibus.

senses.def: to do something or go somewhere quickly
senses.ex: We have to hurry or we'll miss the bus.
senses.exPt: Temos que correr, senão vamos perder o ônibus.

senses.def: the need to do something quickly
senses.ex: Sorry, I can't talk now, I'm in a hurry.
senses.exPt: Desculpa, não posso falar agora, estou com pressa.

senses.def: to cause pain or injury to a part of the body
senses.ex: I hurt my knee playing football.
senses.exPt: Machuquei o joelho jogando futebol.

senses.def: to feel painful
senses.ex: My head hurts. Do you have any medicine?
senses.exPt: Minha cabeça está doendo. Você tem algum remédio?

senses.def: to make someone feel sad or upset
senses.ex: What he said really hurt me.
senses.exPt: O que ele disse me magoou muito.

senses.def: the man that a woman is married to
senses.ex: Her husband works as a nurse at the hospital.
senses.exPt: O marido dela trabalha como enfermeiro no hospital.

senses.def: to make someone be quiet
senses.ex: She hushed the children so she could hear the news.
senses.exPt: Ela fez as crianças se calarem para poder ouvir o noticiário.

senses.def: a small simple building, often made of wood
senses.ex: They spent the night in a small hut in the mountains.
senses.exPt: Eles passaram a noite numa pequena cabana nas montanhas.

senses.def: made from a mix of two different things
senses.ex: We're thinking of buying a hybrid car.
senses.exPt: Estamos pensando em comprar um carro híbrido.

senses.def: keeping yourself and things clean to stay healthy
senses.ex: Good hygiene helps prevent the spread of disease.
senses.exPt: Uma boa higiene ajuda a prevenir a propagação de doenças.

senses.def: a way of speaking that makes something sound bigger or better than it is
senses.ex: Saying it was the best film ever made is a bit of hyperbole.
senses.exPt: Dizer que foi o melhor filme já feito é um pouco de exagero.

senses.def: the short line (-) used to join two words or parts of a word
senses.ex: "Well-known" is written with a hyphen.
senses.exPt: "Well-known" se escreve com hífen.

senses.def: pretending to have beliefs or standards that you do not really have
senses.ex: It's pure hypocrisy to talk about saving water and then wash your car every day.
senses.exPt: É pura hipocrisia falar em economizar água e lavar o carro todo dia.

senses.def: a person who says one thing but does the opposite
senses.ex: He's such a hypocrite: he tells everyone to save money and spends everything.
senses.exPt: Ele é tão hipócrita: manda todo mundo economizar e gasta tudo.

senses.def: saying you believe something but doing the opposite
senses.ex: It's hypocritical to complain about pollution and then drive everywhere.
senses.exPt: É hipócrita reclamar da poluição e depois ir de carro para todo lado.

senses.def: in a way that criticizes others for things you do yourself
senses.ex: He hypocritically criticised others for doing exactly what he did.
senses.exPt: Ele criticava os outros, hipocritamente, por fazerem exatamente o que ele fazia.
